after.zh: 先挪、再放大，就把 [0.25, 0.75] 拉满了 [0, 1]。修图软件的「色阶」「对比度」做的就是这件事。顺序要紧：先放大再挪，挪的量就得跟着变。
after.en: Shift first, then scale, and [0.25, 0.75] fills all of [0, 1]. The "levels" and "contrast" tools in photo editors do exactly this. The order matters: scale first, and the amount you shift by has to change with it.

t.zh: 阴天、起雾，或者镜头上有一层灰，拍出来的照片就灰蒙蒙的：最暗的地方不够黑，最亮的地方不够白，所有亮度都挤在中间一小段里。
t.en: On an overcast or foggy day, or with dust on the lens, photos come out washed out: the darkest parts are not black enough, the brightest not white enough, and every brightness is squeezed into a narrow band in the middle.

t.zh: 这一关的照片，亮度都挤在 0.25 到 0.75 之间。修图软件里的「色阶」能把它拉回 0 到 1。
t.en: In this level's photos, every brightness is squeezed between 0.25 and 0.75. The "levels" tool in a photo editor can stretch it back out to 0 … 1.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：让 0.25 变成 0、0.75 变成 1，中间的亮度按比例拉开。要想的问题：先乘还是先加，结果一样吗？
t.en: Your task in this level: turn 0.25 into 0 and 0.75 into 1, stretching the brightnesses in between in proportion. Something to think about: does it matter whether you multiply or add first?

caption.zh: 第一组测试：灰蒙蒙的方块和拉开后的方块
caption.en: Set 1: a washed-out square and the square stretched

brief.zh: 这些照片灰蒙蒙的：最暗只有 0.25，最亮只有 0.75。把 0.25 变成 0、0.75 变成 1，中间的按比例拉开。
brief.en: These photos are washed out: the darkest is only 0.25 and the brightest only 0.75. Turn 0.25 into 0 and 0.75 into 1, stretching everything in between in proportion.

hint.zh: 先让最暗的那一格落到 0，再想要乘多少，最亮的才会落到 1。
hint.en: First bring the darkest cell down to 0, then work out what to multiply by so the brightest lands on 1.
